Net GST collections increased 18% to Rs 19,635.49 crore in the first half of FY 2026-27, while September net GST rose 14.10%. The state attributed the growth to stronger compliance, enforcement, economic activity and technology-led tax monitoring.

banking-economy.title: HDFC Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank put two Anups atop banking’s big succession puzzle
banking-economy.summary: Anup Bagchi has been appointed as the new MD and CEO of HDFC Bank effective October 26. He succeeds Sashidhar Jagdishan, who chose not to seek reappointment after his six-year term. Kotak Mahindra Bank has also named Anup Saha as its new MD and CEO starting January 1. Saha takes over from Ashok Vaswani, who is also stepping down from his role.
